title.narrative: Hacia una Economa Verde: Apoyo al Plan de Descarbonizacin de Costa Rica II
Towards a Green Economy: Support for Costa Ricas Decarbonization Plan II

description.narrative: El objetivo general es continuar la progresiva transicin del pas hacia cero emisiones netas de Gases Efecto Invernadero (GEI) al 2050, beneficiando a toda la poblacin a travs de reformas para: (i) fortalecimiento de la gestin y monitoreo de la accin climtica en CR; (ii) conservacin y restauracin de ecosistemas de alta captacin de GEI y la sustitucin de prcticas agropecuarias emisoras por fijadoras de GEI (contribuir al aumento de la cobertura boscosa del pas, a la preservacin de los humedales y las reas marinas y al aumento de la proporcin de la produccin agropecuaria generada mediante prcticas bajas en carbono o fijadoras de carbono); y (iii) incentivacin del uso de la energa elctrica y la movilidad activa (alinear las tarifas de la electricidad con los objetivos de electrificacin del uso de la energa y habilitar la electrificacin de la flota vehicular). Bajo estos subsectores se apoyarn las reformas de poltica necesarias para la implementacin del Plan Nacional de Descarbonizacin (PD).

The general objective is to continue the progressive transition of the country towards zero net Greenhouse Gas (GHG) emissions by 2050, benefiting the entire population through reforms to: (i) strengthen the management and monitoring of climate action in CR ; (ii) conservation and restoration of ecosystems with high GHG sequestration and the substitution of emitting agricultural practices for GHG fixers (contribute to the increase in forest cover in the country, the preservation of wetlands and marine areas, and the increase in proportion of agricultural production generated through low-carbon or carbon-fixing practices); (iii) encouragement of the use of electric power and active mobility (align electricity rates with the objectives of electrification of energy use and enable the electrification of the vehicle fleet); and (iv) the promotion of inclusion and gender equality in the National Decarbonization Plan. Under these subsectors, the necessary policy reforms will be supported for the implementation of the National Decarbonization Plan (PD).
